text:
noah patel: Hi all  first-day snag. Im remote in a hotel with a captive portal and my M1 Air can't finish Kandji enrollment. Kandji installer stalls at "Waiting for network" and FileVault hasn't started. The hotel page redirects to a login page and the device never shows the captive portal in Safari. Anyone have a quick workaround?

sarah - IT: Welcome @noah! Captive portals + MDM are pain. Two quick options: 1) tether your phone as a hotspot (simplest), 2) connect to hotel network and open a browser as the local user (sometimes the portal only surfaces in the AP's DNS). Did you try browsing to http://neverssl.com to trigger the portal?

noah patel: Tried neverssl.com and it redirected to the hotel page but Kandji still says "Waiting for network" and the profile didn't apply. I also see a system prompt for FileVault asking for an admin password I don't have.

it-help-bot: Opening ticket INC-2026-22456. Noah: please run `networksetup -getinfo Wi-Fi` and `profiles status -type enrollment` from Terminal and paste outputs. Also try `open http://neverssl.com` then `ping 8.8.8.8` to confirm connectivity.

noah patel: networksetup shows IP assigned, DNS from the hotel. `profiles status` -> "No enrolled MDM". Ping 8.8.8.8 works. Screenshot of captive login page attached.

tony - infra: If ping works but Kandji can't reach the agent endpoint, the hotel's firewall may be blocking outbound ports or the captive portal needs credentials before allowing the Kandji agent to fetch profiles. Easiest workaround: tether to your phone for 5-10 minutes, finish enrollment, then switch back to Wi-Fi. If tethering not possible, we can issue a one-time offline enrollment token that you can run locally. Sarah, can we generate an offline enroll pak for Noah?

sarah - IT: Yup. I can push an offline enroll script via DM or grant a 1-hour temp admin to run the local enroll helper. Which do you prefer @noah? Also, do you have a spare laptop or phone to hotspot with?

noah patel: Phone hotspot available but slow. I'd prefer a short temp admin so I can run the official enroll helper and then let Kandji push any remaining payloads. Also need sudo to install Homebrew and set up my SSH key.

sarah - IT: Approved 90-min TempAccess for temp-noah. DMing creds. Reminder: session is audited and expires automatically. Use only to run the enrolment and install dev tools.

it-help-bot: Temp session created: TEMP-22456. Please run `profiles renew -type enrollment` and then `sudo profiles install -path /path/to/offline-enroll.pkg` if prompted. Ticket updated INC-2026-22456.

noah patel: Got creds, logged in as temp-noah. Ran `profiles renew` and it created a pending enroll command which I accepted. Then ran the offline pkg and `profiles status` now shows "Kandji: Enrolled". FileVault prompt started and shows "Escrow in progress".

network-bot: Note: because the hotel uses DNS hijack for the portal, some services may need explicit allowlisting. For future remote onboarding, prefer a phone hotspot or request a pre-shipped LTE hotspot from IT.

sarah - IT: Good. Once encryption finishes and escrow shows success in Kandji we'll close the ticket. Quick security reminder: avoid installing browser extensions or running unknown installers while on a public/hotel network, even if tethered.

noah patel: FileVault escrow shows success, Kandji dashboard lists device as "Enrolled - online". I installed Homebrew and added my SSH pubkey via the onboarding form. Thanks for the speedy help :heart:

sarah - IT: Closing INC-2026-22456. Welcome aboard @noah! Post a short intro in #general when you have a minute and well send stickers :tada:
